HR / Payroll Supervisor Job at Huko Advisory Services




        
    

        
        At Huko Advisory Services, we help businesses unlock their full potential through smart, strategic, and innovative human capital solutions. Based in Lagos, Nigeria, we provide HR outsourcing, recruitment, training, consulting, and workforce development services to businesses across industries.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HR / Payroll Supervisor

Job Location: Ikota Complex, VGC - Lagos
Reporting to: MD/CEO
Resumption date:November, 2026.

Job Description
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are seeking an experienced HR / Payroll Supervisor to support our Organization and provide invaluable support to our HR department.
	Your role will involve performing a variety of administrative tasks, including updating employee records, screening resumes, and scheduling interviews, Writing of proposals, payroll management


Roles / Responsibilities


	Coordinate and supervise all HR activities and mangement of payroll
	Update our internal databases with new employee information, including contact details and employment forms
	Gather payroll data like leaves, working hours and bank accounts
	Screen resumes and application forms
	Schedule and confirm interviews with candidates
	Post, update and remove job ads from job boards, careers pages and social networks
	Prepare HR-related reports as needed (like training budgets by department)
	Address employee queries about benefits (like number of remaining vacation days)
	Review and distribute company policies in digital formats or hard copies
	Participate in organizing company events and careers days             .


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree in Humanities / Development Studies, Business, International Relations, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years and above experience in HR
	HR certification is an advantage.
	Excellent writing, editing, and research skills.
	Strong computer skills
	Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality work within deadlines.
	High level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.
	Should reside along Lekki - Ajah axis.


Benefits


	Salary: N250,000 monthly
	HMO
	Leave Allowance.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.
